checked: SoSoValue Indexes (SSI) on hyperevm: no protocol contracts there - the whole protocol is on Base and the HyperEVM TVL is plain native HYPE in the protocol's custody wallets. DefiLlama slug sosovalue-indexes (parent#sosovalue, category Indexes); adapter module ssi-protocol/index.js (https://github.com/DefiLlama/DefiLlama-Adapters/blob/main/projects/ssi-protocol/index.js, fetched 2026-11-18) makes ZERO hyperevm calls: it calls getBasket() (0xcd6ef2b0) on three Base-only SSI token proxies - MAG7.ssi 0x9E6A46f294bB67c20F1D1E7AfB0bBEf614403B55, DEFI.ssi 0x164ffdaE2fe3891714bc2968f1875ca4fA1079D0, MEME.ssi 0xdd3acDBDc7b358Df453a6CB6bCA56C92aA5743aA - and books each basket leg to its home chain, with the HYPEREVM_HYPE leg (addr = '', 18 decimals = EVM-native HYPE) counted as hyperevm native. Candidate TVL check: getBasket() eth_call on base at hyperevm block 51,571,691 (2026-11-18) returns HYPEREVM_HYPE 9,541.17422 in MAG7 and 70,188.81412 in DEFI, none in MEME; 79,729.99 HYPE x $68.9256 (coins.llama.fi coingecko:hyperliquid) = $5.49M, matching DefiLlama currentChainTvls Hyperliquid L1 $5,462,886 (candidate 5,346,248). Docs (https://sosovalue.gitbook.io/sosovalue-indices/solution-design/key-addresses-on-base, fetched 2026-11-18) list EVERY contract under "Key Addresses (on Base)": the 3 index tokens, USSI 0x3a46ed8FCeb6eF1ADA2E4600A522AE7e24D2Ed18, swap 0x640cB7201810BC920835A598248c4fe4898Bb5e0, factory 0xb04eB6b64137d1673D46731C8f84718092c50B0D, issuer 0xdc74D8C5D9a900fdF8a6D03Ad419b236c9A1AD1d, rebalancer 0x242626E1eCe44601A69d9BC3f72a755Eb393f4b1, feeManager 0x996c93827Ab4C55B1044aDd903D2bDb0dcd546BA, stakeFactory 0x585834242BB31427B1dC7486DD4BDe7c724e35c1, assetLocking 0x935A4B1F6F3E891a226b2522ac22d45Ce5839383, owner 0xd463D3d8333b7AD6a14d00e1700C80AF5A37F751 (Cobo custody). eth_getCode on hyperevm = 0x for all twelve of those addresses; control in the same run: eth_getCode of two contract targets taken from the latest hyperevm block 51,571,691 returned 262 and 10,344 hex chars. Mechanism (docs Mint/Burn/Rebalance): mint/burn/rebalance are quote-driven and run through the Base issuer (addMintRequest / addRedeemRequest / confirmMintRequest / claim on Base); the underlying moves between the PMM and the protocol's custody wallets, which are not SSI contracts on hyperevm. Same family on other chains is already recorded dead_end: base sosovalue_basis (id 598, all USSI entry points PARTICIPANT_ROLE/onlyOwner gated) and bsc sosovalue_indexes (id 617, no BSC contracts, MAG7 implementation rebalance/startRebalance/collectFeeTokenset role-gated). No contract on hyperevm, so no callable function and nothing that could pay a stranger there.
